records.text: The U.S. Secret Service determined there were no credible threats to the Turning Point USA rally at the University of Georgia; the site was secure and there were no known threats to JD Vance.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep 1mYNOqzAdXs)

appearances.snippet: the u.s secret service determined there were no credible threats to tuesday's turning point usa rally at the university of georgia even as a planned co-appearance by Erika Kirk was canceled over unspecified security concerns. A person familiar with the matter tells CBS News, according to the source, that the site was secure and there were no known threats to the protectee.

verification.notes: CBS News reported, from a person familiar with the matter, that the Secret Service found no credible threat tied to the UGA venue or JD Vance, that the site was secure, and that there were no known threats to the protectee. This verifies the statement as a report of the determination, with medium confidence because the underlying source was anonymous rather than an on-record Secret Service release.

sources.title: Secret Service determines no credible threats to UGA rally after Erika Kirk cancellation, source says
sources.relevance: Reports the Secret Service threat assessment, secure site, and absence of known threats to JD Vance.

records.text: Hostile messages Erika Kirk may have received, including on social media, were not part of any identified or actionable threat stream monitored by federal authorities.

appearances.snippet: Now, while Kirk may have received hostile messages, including on social media, those were not part of any identified or actionable threat stream that was monitored by federal authorities.
